about.label: About
paragraphs: For a year I was a full stack developer at a cybersecurity startup. I built the screens customers worked in, the services behind them, and the connections to six outside tools like Jira and GitHub. I also shipped an AI feature that turns plain text into search filters, and built the tests that checked its answers before launch.

Working with me is simple. You send the design, I tell you what it takes and when it's ready, and you hear from me before you need to ask. Every question gets an answer within one working day, in Hebrew or English.
